title: Coastal & Briny
summary: Anchovy, capers, olives, seaweed — brine is seasoning; taste before adding more salt.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — coastal & briny is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: salt, seafood, acid. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Finish with lemon not more salt
Fresh herbs and olive oil soften brine; starch (bread, potatoes) absorbs intensity.
